Short title, extent and commencement

[KHYBER PAMITUNICHWA] FOODSTUFFS (CONTROL) ORDER, 1975
[KHYBER PAMITUNICHWA] FOODSTUFFS (CONTROL) ORDER, 1975
1. Short title, extent and commencement.--(1) This Order may be
called the 6[Khyber Pakhtunkhwa] Foodstuffs (Control Order, 1975.
(2) It extends to the whole of
the 7[Khyber Pakhtunkhwa].
(3) It shall come into force at
once.
6. Subs. by the Constitution (18th Amdt.)
Act, (X of 2010) for the word "N.W.F.P.".
7. Subs. by the Constitution (18th Amdt.)
Act, (X of 2010) for the word "N.W.F.P.".

Definitions

[KHYBER PAMITUNICHWA] FOODSTUFFS (CONTROL) ORDER, 1975
[KHYBER PAMITUNICHWA] FOODSTUFFS (CONTROL) ORDER, 1975
2. Definitions.--In this Order, unless the context otherwise
requires;-
(a) "District
Magistrate" means the District Magistral of a
District;
(b) "Foodstuffs"
means the commodities specified in the Schedule;
(c) "Government"
means the Government of the 8[Khyber
Pakhtunkhwa];
(d) "Inspector"
means, within his respective jurisdiction a District Magistrate, a Magistrate,
any officer of the Food Department not below the rank of Foodsgrains
Inspector, any officer of the Police Department not below the rank of
sub-inspector, any Revenue Officer not below the rank of a Naib-Tehsidlar
and such other officers, as may be designated by the District Magistrate, for
purposes of this Order;
(e) "Schedule"
means the Schedule appended to this Order; and
(f) "trader" means any person carrying on, in conjunction
with any other business or not, the business of foodstuffs, whether wholesale
or retail.
8. Subs. by the Constitution (18th Arndt.) Act, (X of 2010) for the
word "N.W.F.P.".

Fixation of prices and appointment of District Committee

[KHYBER PAMITUNICHWA] FOODSTUFFS (CONTROL) ORDER, 1975
[KHYBER PAMITUNICHWA] FOODSTUFFS (CONTROL) ORDER, 1975
3. Fixation of prices and appointment of District Committee.--(1)
As soon as may be after the notification of this Order in the official Gazette,
a District Magistrate, may, in consultation with the District Committee or
otherwise, fix prices of the foodstuffs, and different prices may be fixed for
different localities in the District.
(2) For the purpose of sub-clause
(1), the District Magistrate shall appoint a District Committee consisting of
such number of representatives of traders and consumers and such other
officers, as he may deem fit.

Disposal of foodstuffs at fixed prices

[KHYBER PAMITUNICHWA] FOODSTUFFS (CONTROL) ORDER, 1975
[KHYBER PAMITUNICHWA] FOODSTUFFS (CONTROL) ORDER, 1975
4. Disposal of foodstuffs at fixed prices.--No trader shall sell or
dispose of or attempt to sell or dispose of any foodstuff except at the price
fixed by the District Magistrate.

Prohibition of hoarding or withholding from sale of foodstuffs

[KHYBER PAMITUNICHWA] FOODSTUFFS (CONTROL) ORDER, 1975
[KHYBER PAMITUNICHWA] FOODSTUFFS (CONTROL) ORDER, 1975
5. Prohibition of hoarding or withholding from sale of foodstuffs.--No
trader shall hoard or withhold from sale any foodstuffs which
is ordinary possessed and kept for sale.

Traders to provide facilities for inspection

[KHYBER PAMITUNICHWA] FOODSTUFFS (CONTROL) ORDER, 1975
[KHYBER PAMITUNICHWA] FOODSTUFFS (CONTROL) ORDER, 1975
6. Traders to provide facilities for inspection.--Every trader
shall give all facilities at all reasonable times to any Inspector for the
inspection of his stocks at any shop, godown or other
place used by him for the storage or sale of foodstuffs.

Inspection

[KHYBER PAMITUNICHWA] FOODSTUFFS (CONTROL) ORDER, 1975
[KHYBER PAMITUNICHWA] FOODSTUFFS (CONTROL) ORDER, 1975
7. Inspection.--For more effective enforcement of this Order, an
Inspector may; (a) require any person to give any information in his possession
with respect to the purchase, sale, storage; transfer or disposal of a
foodstuff which has been or is in his possession or under this control; (b)
enter and search any premises and seize any quantity of the foodstuffs in
respect of which he has reason to believe that a contravention of his Order has
been, is being or is about to be committed; (c)
inspect or cause to be inspected any books or other documents relating
to the purchase, sale, storage, transfer or disposal of foodstuffs.

Penalty

[KHYBER PAMITUNICHWA] FOODSTUFFS (CONTROL) ORDER, 1975
[KHYBER PAMITUNICHWA] FOODSTUFFS (CONTROL) ORDER, 1975
8. Penalty.--If any person contravenes any provisions of this
Order, he shall, as provided in section 6 of the Foodstuffs (Control) Act, 1958
(Act XX of 1958), be punishable with imprisonment for a term which may extend
to three years, or with fine, or with both and the Court trying such
contravention shall direct that the stock or quantity of the foodstuffs
together with packages and coverings thereof, in respect of which the Court is
satisfied that the offence has been committed, shall be forfeited to the
Government unless for reasons to be recorded in writing, the Court is of the
opinion that such direction should not be made, in respect of the whole or, as
the case may be, any portion of the stock.

subordinate to Government may also be exercised by Government.
